svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: measurement of the response of a filter (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, band-
What to draw: the VNA with P1 and P2; the filter in the middle, with the input connected to P1
and the output connected to P2, each with a test lead.
Details: the filter's input (IN) and output (OUT) clearly indicated (the filter is a
directional device: the user must know which side goes to P1). The filter symbol can be the
classic box with the curve (do not choose the type: it applies to all four).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
